subject: [PATCH v6 01/12] mm, swap: add virtual swap device infrastructure

2026-10-21.patch_summary: This patch introduces a virtual swap device infrastructure for Linux, allowing the kernel to route swapouts through a virtual layer that can utilize zswap and zero-filled pages without a physical swap device. The virtual device is created when the 'vswap' kernel parameter is enabled (defaulting to on if CONFIG_VSWAP_DEFAULT_ON is set) and lives for the lifetime of the kernel, capping at 8 TiB with 4 KiB pages. The patch also includes dynamic cluster infrastructure and a 64-bit architecture requirement. It lays the groundwork for subsequent patches that will implement allocation paths and backends for the virtual swap layer.
